visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian woman with short black hair and a vibrant green textured sweater sits indoors against a plain white wall. She looks directly at the camera, speaking with expressive facial features and frequent hand gestures to emphasize her points about her brand journey. (2) As she continues her monologue, a large red graphic containing the traditional Chinese text "以下省略一萬字" dramatically overlays the center of the frame. Her hands are now clasped together in a praying gesture, and her eyes look upward as if reminiscing. (3) The scene shifts to the woman enthusiastically holding up a bright red, flower-shaped leather handbag with a long matching strap. She moves the bag around to show its shape while smiling broadly, showcasing the product against her green sweater background. (4) A series of quick cuts displays the woman modeling the bags in various outfits: wearing a black shirt and long denim skirt with the red bag, then a pale green shirt with pink pants and a blue denim flower bag, posing with a confident smile. (5) High-definition close-up shots are inserted to highlight the bag's unique physical features, such as a small metallic tag with three flower icons, a custom-designed flower-shaped silver zipper pull, and a functional adjustable buckle on the side of the strap. (6) The final shots return to the woman in her initial green sweater and beige trousers, wearing the black version of the flower bag cross-body. She performs several poses, turning sideways and back to demonstrate how the bag hangs and complements different styling angles.
